summary: The IDF is conducting simultaneous military operations across Gaza, Lebanon, and the Iran front while raising readiness of additional divisions amid tensions in Judea and Samaria. Iran has declared a shift from defensive to offensive posture and asserts control over the Strait of Hormuz, even as a Kuwaiti oil tanker was reportedly targeted there. Diplomatic channels between the US and Iran have collapsed, with the Trump administration telling mediators it will not return to the June memorandum terms.
key_points: IDF Chief of Staff Zamir directed raising readiness of another regular division and immediate deployment of units across all theaters from Iran to Lebanon and Gaza (Source: @idf_telegram/24998).
IRGC declared Iran shifting from defensive to offensive posture, preserving asymmetric capabilities and asserting control over the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @presstv/204452).
IDF eliminated multiple Hamas commanders including Asmaeil Bars in Khan Yunis and Balal Talaqei in Shati, Gaza (Source: @inon_yttach/9969).
A Kuwaiti oil tanker was reportedly targeted in the Strait of Hormuz amid escalating maritime tensions (Source: @kianmeli1/91158).
Israeli Air Force struck Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon including near Nabatieh, with 178 alerts and 114 drones detected in one day (Source: @redlinkleb/39078).
Trump administration informed mediators repeatedly it will not return to the June memorandum of understanding terms with Iran (Source: @VahidOnline/78065).
Iran's SNSC Secretary Rezaei met Qatar's PM Al-Thani in Tehran while Iran's parliament head stated no ship crosses Hormuz without armed forces permission (Source: @presstv/204458).
Shin Bet chief Ronen Bar held direct contacts with Hamas abroad without third-party mediation, with Netanyahu's approval, to advance hostage negotiations (Source: @yediotnews25/134388).

sections.executive_summary: The IDF is advancing battle procedures across all theaters from Iran to Lebanon and Gaza while raising readiness of additional divisions amid tensions in Judea and Samaria. Iran has declared a shift from defensive to offensive posture and asserts control over the Strait of Hormuz, even as a Kuwaiti oil tanker was reportedly targeted there. Diplomatic channels between Washington and Tehran have collapsed, with the Trump administration telling mediators it will not return to the June memorandum terms.
iran: IRGC Intelligence Organization declared Iran is consolidating and enhancing national resilience while shifting from a defensive to an offensive posture, preserving asymmetric capabilities against the US (Source: @presstv/204452).

Iran's IRGC intelligence organization warned of intensifying social dissatisfaction, claiming enemies failed to change Iran's government through military attacks, and accused Mossad of operating a secret structure for internal pressure (Source: @VahidOnline/78063).

Iran's parliament National Security Committee head Azizi stated no ship crosses the Strait of Hormuz without armed forces permission, asserting Iran's control over the waterway (Source: @naya_foriraq/88654).
A Kuwaiti oil tanker was reportedly targeted in the Strait of Hormuz, signaling escalating maritime risks in the strategic waterway (Source: @kianmeli1/91158).
Iran's SNSC Secretary Major General Mohsen Rezaei met Qatar's Foreign/Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, reiterating Iran's distrust of America (Source: @presstv/204458).

The Trump administration told mediators repeatedly it does not want to return to the June memorandum of understanding terms with Iran, prioritizing economic pressure instead (Source: @VahidOnline/78065).
A suspicious convoy was spotted on Chamran highway in Tehran at 23:15 local time, though no further details about its composition were provided (Source: @shin_persian/9151).
israel: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir directed raising readiness of another regular division to reinforce security in Judea and Samaria, and preparing for immediate deployment of units and battalions for reinforcement across all theaters (Source: @idf_telegram/24998).
IDF eliminated Hamas commander Asmaeil Mohammed Ibrahim Bars, who held hostages Idan Alexander, Matan Tangoa, and Avraham Mangesis in a tunnel in Khan Yunis (Source: @inon_yttach/9969).

Defense Minister Katz declared the ultimatum deadline has ended, stating every balloon and kite launch from Gaza to southern communities will be met with a severe response (Source: @inon_yttach/9967).

Shin Bet chief Ronen Bar held direct contacts with Hamas abroad without third-party mediation, with Netanyahu's approval, to advance hostage negotiations, according to information previously banned from broadcast (Source: @yediotnews25/134388).

IDF eliminated Balal Ibrahim Salah Talaqei, commander in Hamas's anti-tank array in Shati, and Azam Rafaat Abd Abdelah, operative in Khan Yunis brigade, continuing operations in Gaza (Source: @inon_yttach/9971).
Zamir noted the IDF faces an empty purse, stating budget constraints damage readiness at a time when soldiers are stretched across all fronts (Source: @idf_telegram/24998).

MDA teams treated two unconscious people in their 70s and 80s in an apartment on Moshe Dayan Boulevard in Jerusalem, with firefighters conducting searches for hazardous materials (Source: @yediotnews25/134380).
gaza_west_bank: IDF eliminated Hamas commander Asmaeil Mohammed Ibrahim Bars in Khan Yunis, who held hostages Idan Alexander, Matan Tangoa, and Avraham Mangesis in a tunnel (Source: @inon_yttach/9969).
IDF eliminated Balal Ibrahim Salah Talaqei, commander in Hamas's anti-tank array in Shati, and Azam Rafaat Abd Abdelah, operative in Khan Yunis brigade of Hamas (Source: @inon_yttach/9971).

Defense Minister Katz stated the ultimatum deadline has ended and every balloon and kite launch from Gaza to southern communities will be met with a severe response, including potential population evacuation (Source: @New_security8200/203455).
Occupation forces raided homes and launched gas bombs during an incursion into Madama village south of Nablus in the West Bank (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387271).
Artillery shelling targeted Wadi al-Salouqi toward the town of Tulin in the West Bank (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387275).
lebanon: Israeli Air Force attacked Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon, with reports of strikes near the city of Nabatieh (Source: @New_security8200/203451).
Daily statistics reported 178 total alerts, 114 drones detected, with Kfar Tibnit and Nabatieh al-Fouqa each recording 18 drone sightings (Source: @redlinkleb/39078).
Four drone strikes were recorded: two on Kfar Rman and two on Dahieh plus the industrial city in Nabatieh al-Fouqa (Source: @redlinkleb/39078).
Thirteen airstrikes were recorded targeting Ali al-Tahrir (3), Nabatieh al-Fouqa (3), Mansouri (2), Arab Salim (2), and several other locations (Source: @redlinkleb/39078).
Twenty-one artillery shells were fired, with Mansouri receiving 6, Mifdun outskirts 3, and Dahieh Kfar Rman 2 (Source: @redlinkleb/39078).
IDF attacks were reported in the Nabatieh area in southern Lebanon (Source: @inon_yttach/9965).
syria_iraq: Syrian leader Ahmad al-Sharaa (Mohammed al-Julani) formally appointed former commander of Syrian Democratic Forces Mazloum Abdi as a presidential advisor (Source: @SharghDaily/180405).

Iraq's PM financial advisor stated 40 million citizens benefit from state salaries totaling 7.7 trillion Iraqi dinars monthly, with oil priced at $50-60 per barrel in the budget (Source: @naya_foriraq/88647).

Iraq confirmed no banking relations with Iran and no dollar-denominated payments since 2011, while Iranian gas imports reach 18 million cubic meters supporting the network with 4500 MW (Source: @naya_foriraq/88647).
gulf_states: A Kuwaiti oil tanker was reportedly targeted in the Strait of Hormuz, raising concerns about maritime security in the Gulf (Source: @kianmeli1/91158).
Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani met Iranian officials in Tehran, with SNSC Secretary Rezaei reiterating Iran's distrust of America (Source: @presstv/204458).
Oman's foreign minister spoke with Iranian officials about reaching an understanding regarding ship passage through the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @VahidOnline/78065).
Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir traveled to Tehran earlier in the week for talks, as part of mediation efforts to revive negotiations between Washington and Tehran (Source: @VahidOnline/78065).

The Trump administration informed mediators it has no intention of returning to the June memorandum terms, dealing a setback to Qatar, Oman, and Pakistan's efforts to revive negotiations (Source: @VahidOnline/78065).

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's declared shift from defensive to offensive posture combined with its assertion of control over the Strait of Hormuz and the reported targeting of a Kuwaiti oil tanker signals heightened maritime and regional risk. The IRGC intelligence organization's warning about social dissatisfaction and its accusation that Mossad is operating internal pressure structures suggest Tehran perceives multi-vector threats. The IDF's simultaneous operations across Gaza, Lebanon, and the Iran front, with additional divisions being raised, indicate a sustained multi-front conflict trajectory.
sections.regional_response: Qatar's PM Al-Thani met Iranian officials in Tehran while Oman's foreign minister pursued talks on Hormuz passage, and Pakistan's army chief traveled to Tehran for negotiations, though the Trump administration has closed the door on returning to the June memorandum terms. Israel's allies are coordinating military readiness across multiple theaters while diplomatic backchannels with Hamas continue through Shin Bet chief Bar's direct contacts. Gulf states face direct maritime threats as evidenced by the Kuwaiti tanker incident, complicating their mediation roles.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iran's IRGC claims to have identified a secret Mossad structure operating inside Iran through connections with opposition groups, though this claim could not be independently verified from the source material. The suspicious convoy spotted on Tehran's Chamran highway warrants monitoring but lacks contextual details for assessment. Iraq confirmed zero banking or electronic payment relations with Iran despite ongoing gas imports of 18 million cubic meters supporting 4500 MW, indicating strict financial decoupling between the two neighbors.
